title: Three accessible days in Goa from Pune
summary: A relaxed three-day trip from Pune to Goa for a wheelchair user, within about 30,000 rupees. You fly both ways, stay in one accessible hotel in Candolim and keep each day short. Step-free places are confirmed first. Fort Aguada and Fontainhas are only partly accessible, so the plan keeps them optional. Please confirm the details with each venue before you go.

traveler.notes: Budget about 30,000 rupees. Prefers short days and step-free routes.

days.title: Fly to Goa and settle in

items.name: Pune International Airport
items.note: Request wheelchair assistance when booking. Arrive 2 hours early.

items.name: Dabolim Airport (Goa)
items.note: Pre-book an accessible cab to Candolim (about 55 minutes).

items.name: Taj Fort Aguada Resort
items.note: Check in to an accessible room. Rest this afternoon.

items.name: Dinner at the hotel
items.note: Step-free dining room; ask for a quiet table.

items.name: Miramar Beach Promenade
items.note: Gentle, paved morning walk or roll along the sea.

items.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Walk
items.note: Optional: short loop with a companion on the flatter streets.

items.name: Gunpowder Restaurant
items.note: Lunch, booked ahead for a wheelchair-friendly table.

items.name: Fort Aguada
items.note: Drive to the viewpoint only. Skip the lighthouse steps.

items.name: Check out
items.note: Keep an hour spare for the taxi.

items.name: Dabolim Airport (Goa)
items.note: Return flight; request assistance again at check-in.

access.summary: Step-free from kerb to gate, lifts to all levels and accessible toilets. Wheelchair assistance is available on request through the airline; book it at least 48 hours ahead.

sources.title: Airports Authority of India: Pune airport facilities
DGCA guidance on assistance for persons with disability

draft.subject: Wheelchair assistance request: Pune to Goa, 14 March
draft.body:
Hello,

I will travel from Pune to Goa on 14 March and use a wheelchair. Could you please confirm that:
1. Wheelchair assistance is arranged from the terminal entrance to the aircraft door.
2. An aisle wheelchair is available for boarding.
3. A step-free drop-off point is near the departures entrance.

Thank you,
A traveller

access.summary: Ground-level terminal with ramps and lifts. Accessible toilets are reported near arrivals. Pre-paid taxis can take a folded wheelchair; wheelchair-accessible cabs need to be booked ahead.

sources.title: Travel forum: wheelchair at Goa airport

draft.subject: Arrival assistance at Dabolim
draft.body: Hello, I land at Dabolim on 14 March at 11:20 and use a wheelchair. Can you confirm assistance at arrivals and an accessible cab to Candolim?

access.summary: Hotel lists accessible rooms with roll-in showers and ramps to the lobby and pool deck. Beach access is by a sloping path that may be hard in a manual chair.

sources.title: Booking.com: facilities for guests with disabilities

draft.subject: Accessible room booking and step-free routes
draft.body:
Dear Reservations Team,

I would like to book an accessible room for 14 to 17 March. Please confirm in writing:
- The room has a roll-in shower and a clear turning space of 1.5 m.
- The route from reception to the room has no steps.
- A ramp or lift serves the restaurant and pool.

Kind regards

access.summary: A 17th-century fort on a laterite hill. Parking is close to the lower fort, but paths are steep and uneven. The lighthouse has steep steps. Best enjoyed from the viewpoint by car.

sources.title: Archaeological Survey of India: Fort Aguada

draft.subject: Fort Aguada access
draft.body: Hello, I use a wheelchair. Is there a drive-up point near the upper fort viewpoint, and any step-free path?

access.summary: A paved seafront walk with kerb ramps and public parking. Quiet in the mornings. Sand beyond the promenade is not wheelchair friendly.

draft.subject: Accessible parking at Miramar
draft.body: Hello, could you confirm the location of accessible parking and the nearest accessible toilet along the promenade?

access.summary: Narrow lanes, some cobbled and with high kerbs. A short guided loop on the flatter streets is possible with a companion.

draft.subject: Fontainhas guided walk
draft.body: Hello, do you offer a step-free route for a wheelchair user in Fontainhas?

access.summary: Ground-floor dining with a ramped entrance. Tables are close together at peak hours, so ask for a corner table when booking.

sources.title: Review: wheelchair friendly dining in Goa

draft.subject: Table for a wheelchair user
draft.body: Hello, I would like to book a table for 2 at 20:00 with space for a wheelchair. Is the entrance step-free and is there an accessible toilet?

access.summary: Lifts connect the platforms, and porters or battery cars assist on request. Allow 30 extra minutes.

draft.subject: Wheelchair assistance at Madgaon
draft.body: Hello Station Master, I will depart on 17 March and need wheelchair assistance from the entrance to the coach. Please confirm.

tips: Book wheelchair assistance with the airline at least 48 hours ahead.
Ask the hotel to confirm the room's shower type and door width in writing.
Carry a printed copy of each confirmation message you receive.
Avoid the beach sand sections unless you have a beach wheelchair; some shacks lend them.
Keep a little buffer money; accessible cabs usually cost more than regular taxis.
